newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Goldfields falls on profit downgrade.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Goldfields falls on profit downgrade.

text.p: SYDNEY, Jan 23 (Reuter) Shares in goldminer Goldfields Ltd fell over five percent on Thursday after the group's lower profit forecast for the year to June 30, 1997, which was announced after Wednesday's market close.
At 1.05 p.m. (0205 GMT), Goldfields shares were 13 cents or 5.96 percent down at A$2.05, with over 73,729 shares traded.

On Wednesday, Goldfields said net profit before abnormals for 1996/97 to between A$10 million and A$15 million. The downgrade follows an earlier revised forecast for 1996/97 within the range of A$20 milion to A$25 million in late August.

Listed Australian gold stocks were under pressure on Thursday following the bullion price hitting a 40-month low when it slipped under US$350.00 per ounce in London for the first time since mid-September.
Goldfields is about 57 percent owned by RGC Ltd.
RGC shares were three cents down at A$5.35 at 1.10 p.m. (0210 GMT). -- Sydney newsroom 61-2 9373-1800
